repository.name: @webex/plugin-team-memberships
repository.purpose: Public plugin registered as webex.teamMemberships that manages Webex team memberships through the Webex REST API team/memberships resource (catalog service hydra): create POSTs the caller's membership object (teamId plus personId or personEmail, optionally isModerator), get and remove take a membership object or its id, list sends its options as the query and resolves a webex-core Page, update PUTs the whole membership object, and remove resolves undefined on 204. Each method sends one request through webex.request and resolves the response; nothing is validated, cached, persisted, or logged.

commands.unit-test: [NEEDS HUMAN INPUT] -- package.json defines no test:unit script and the package has no test/unit directory; its only spec, test/integration/spec/team-memberships.js, runs only under test:browser, which currently bundles nothing. Add a unit suite and script before recording a command here.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/plugin-team-memberships package entry
public_interfaces.audience: SDK bundles (webex, webex-node) and applications that build their own webex instance
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package registers TeamMemberships as public plugin 'teamMemberships' with no config; the first registration of the name wins. The default export TeamMemberships is the only export.

public_interfaces.name: webex.teamMemberships methods
public_interfaces.notes: Each method sends one hydra team/memberships request. create POSTs the caller's object unchanged; get, update, and remove take membership.id, else the argument, and throw a TypeError synchronously on null or undefined; update also sends a string argument as the body; list resolves a webex-core Page; remove resolves undefined on 204. Nothing is validated or cached.

public_interfaces.name: package scripts
public_interfaces.notes: build runs build:src, which writes dist. The aggregate test script runs test:style, then exits 1 because test:unit is not defined (it also names test:integration, which is not defined either); it is deliberately not a manifest command.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not send team membership requests other than through this.request with service hydra.
negative_guidance.why: webex-core interceptors add authorization, resolve the catalog, and convert errors (INV-001).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not drop the object-or-id argument of get, update, or remove.
negative_guidance.why: The JSDoc and callers pass either form (INV-002).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not validate or rewrite the caller's membership object without a change request.
negative_guidance.why: The service owns membership rules and callers rely on the body passing through (INV-004).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log person emails, person ids, or team ids through webex.logger.
negative_guidance.why: They identify users and teams; the plugin logs nothing today.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the behavior reference.
negative_guidance.why: Its only example uses webex.team-memberships, which is not valid JavaScript; see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.
